variants.headline: Still in view: business-start grant programme ends
variants.sub: Business-starting support under {programme} has come to an end.
variants.body:
The grant programme {programme} for people starting a business has ended. Coverage of this story continues; the original event remains the starting point for the questions examined here.

A person trying to start a business is still a person whose household matters. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
